offering_description.value: Digital manufacturer of custom prototype and low-volume production parts for engineers and product developers. It makes parts by injection molding, CNC machining, 3D printing and sheet metal fabrication, with quotes and orders placed online.

primary_products.value: custom injection-molded parts; CNC-machined parts; 3D-printed parts; sheet metal parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: Engineers and product developers at manufacturers, startups and large OEMs

end_markets.value: industrial machinery; consumer products; medical devices; aerospace; automotive; electronics

revenue_model.value: product sales: Custom manufactured parts sold per order, priced by quote

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Makes custom parts from customer designs in its own plants, sold directly to product developers and OEMs

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia, with manufacturing in the United States and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: injection molding, CNC machining, 3D printing and sheet metal fabrication for the same product developers

distribution_channels.value: online: Online quoting and ordering platform used by most customers; direct sales: Direct sales team serving engineering and procurement accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules, quality certifications such as ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 are held for customer parts but no operating license is needed
